rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: few - the palm parkway; one tree per car-park island end (zone 106 -> about 80)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). Bridge Motors' ten builder trees go (nine palms 9-12 m apart along the lot's two street fronts behind the iron bollards, a jacaranda); four palms come back on their own spots: every other palm of each front, so the dealer's parkway stays and the cars on show can be seen.

trees.why: the strip's parkway in front of Bridge Motors, behind the iron bollards: the palm parkway
the parkway 24 m on, by the sales office: every other palm, the lot stays in view from the road
the lot's south street front, behind the bollards: the parkway goes round the corner
the south front 18 m on, the row's west end
